propositions: Cumulative counter streams in observability.sh advance their offset file before CloudWatch accepts the put-metric-data call, causing permanent metric loss on transient AWS failures
A failed CloudWatch publication leaves the offset advanced, so the next run computes zero from an already-incremented baseline instead of retrying the accumulated delta
All seven affected metric streams (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt helper, and G2P) share the same defective construct of premature offset acknowledgement
Offset should advance only after successful CloudWatch publication; on AWS failure it must remain byte-identical to allow the next interval to retry the accumulated count
The whole-script PATH-shim test confirms offset 2/source 7 advances to 7 before failure, making next successful run publish 0 instead of 5 for every stream
Reset and zero-delta behaviors must remain unchanged; systemd exit contract stays zero regardless of individual AWS call failures
